name: HOHUP
recent: Ho Hup 正面临清盘呈请，该呈请已延期至 2026 年 12 月 15 日；同时公司获得额外六个月时间提交重组计划，新截止日期为 2027 年 4 月。公司 2026 财年审计报告被出具无法表示意见，并提及持续经营重大不确定性。公司将于 2026 年 11 月 30 日召开第 52 届年度股东大会。
notable: 清盘呈请延期至 2026 年 12 月 15 日。
获得额外六个月提交重组计划，截止日期为 2027 年 4 月。
将于 2026 年 11 月 30 日召开第 52 届年度股东大会。
risks: 审计报告被出具无法表示意见，并提及持续经营重大不确定性。
公司处于 PN17 财务困境状态。

news.title: Ho Hup Winding-Up Petition Adjourned to 15 December 2026
Ho Hup gets another six months to submit regularisation plan, deadline now April 2027

recent_en: Ho Hup is facing a winding-up petition, which has been adjourned to 15 December 2026; the company has also been given an additional six months to submit its regularisation plan, with the new deadline in April 2027. The audit report for FY2026 contains a disclaimer of opinion and material uncertainty related to going concern.
notable_en: Granted an additional six months to submit regularisation plan, deadline April 2027.
52nd AGM to be held on 30 November 2026.
risks_en: Audit report contains a disclaimer of opinion and material uncertainty related to going concern.
The company faces a winding-up petition.
The company is in PN17 financial distress status.
